parameters.query: SELECT b.id, c.full_name, c.phone, b.scheduled_for, b.service_type FROM bookings b JOIN customers c ON c.id=b.customer_id WHERE b.status IN ('scheduled','confirmed') AND b.reminder_24h_sent=false AND c.consent_sms=true AND b.scheduled_for BETWEEN now()+interval '23 hours' AND now()+interval '24 hours';

SELECT b.id, c.full_name, c.phone, b.scheduled_for, b.service_type FROM bookings b JOIN customers c ON c.id=b.customer_id WHERE b.status IN ('scheduled','confirmed') AND b.reminder_2h_sent=false AND c.consent_sms=true AND b.scheduled_for BETWEEN now()+interval '105 minutes' AND now()+interval '120 minutes';

parameters.query: UPDATE bookings SET reminder_24h_sent=true WHERE id=$1; INSERT INTO communication_logs (channel,direction,to_addr,provider,template,status) VALUES ('sms','outbound',$2,'gatewayapi','sms_reminder_24h','sent'); INSERT INTO events (event_name,payload,source_system) VALUES ('appointment_reminder_sent', jsonb_build_object('booking_id',$1::text,'window','24h'),'n8n');

UPDATE bookings SET reminder_2h_sent=true WHERE id=$1; INSERT INTO communication_logs (channel,direction,to_addr,provider,template,status) VALUES ('sms','outbound',$2,'gatewayapi','sms_reminder_2h','sent'); INSERT INTO events (event_name,payload,source_system) VALUES ('appointment_reminder_sent', jsonb_build_object('booking_id',$1::text,'window','2h'),'n8n');
